name: Lin Changqing
profile: Lin Changqing (林长青) appears on the 2021 Hurun China list via Medicilon, a Shanghai preclinical CRO. Shareholder disclosures describe him as a relative by marriage of Medicilon co-controller Chen Jinzhang (nephew-in-law) and of shareholder Chen Guoxing (brother-in-law). No further public profile found.
interesting_fact: Medicilon's actual controllers are founder Chun-Lin Chen and Chen Jinzhang (acting-in-concert agreement); several other shareholders, including Lin, are their relatives but not acting-in-concert parties.
notes: Very low public profile; relationship info from a search-result summary of Sohu shareholder disclosure (page could not be loaded directly). Contact is Medicilon's company marketing email, not personal.

name: Sui Guodong
current_role: Founder and Chairman, Zhidemai Technology (值得买科技, SMZDM, 300785.SZ)
profile: Sui Guodong (隋国栋) founded SMZDM ('What's Worth Buying'), China's shopping-recommendation and consumer-content platform, in 2010 and took it public in Shenzhen; post-IPO he controlled about 50.8% of the shares. As chairman he focuses on strategy, and in May 2024 launched an 'all-in AI' strategy to rebuild the core app as AI-native and expand overseas.
interesting_fact: In May 2024 he announced a full AI strategy for Zhidemai, planning to turn its core apps into AI-native products and push overseas.
deep_cut_fact: smzdm.com launched on 30 June 2010 as Sui's personal 'geek' blog of product finds and reviews; early on the site would crash if ~300 people visited at once - five years later it drew tens of millions of daily visits.
notes: Company insists on platform neutrality ('我们绝不站队' - won't take investment from any e-commerce platform; ifanr 2015). Reported as first president of the Fengtai District International Chamber of Commerce (search summary, unverified).

name: He Zenglin
current_role: Chairman (and general manager), Xi'an Tianhe Defense Technology Co., Ltd. (天和防务, 300397.SZ)
profile: He Zenglin (贺增林) is the founder, chairman and actual controller of Xi'an Tianhe Defense Technology, a Shenzhen-listed defense electronics and communications company (about 25% stake per 2026 reporting). A serial Xi'an entrepreneur since the 1990s, he still chairs the company and was listed as chairman and GM in its 2025 filings.
interesting_fact: Before defense electronics he ran a string of Xi'an ventures: an electrical-machinery firm (1994-99), a network-engineering company (2001-05) and even a culture-and-tourism company, Shaanxi Yuhe (2000-10).
deep_cut_fact: His first company was Xi'an Xinfeng Electrical Machinery (西安信风机电), which he chaired and managed from 1994 to 1999, before founding Xi'an Tianwei Electronic System Engineering in 2001.
notes: Hurun listing shared with Liu Danying. Best route is the board secretary office (Chen Hua) via the published IR email.

name: Yang Yinfen
current_role: Director and Honorary Chairman, Bestore Co., Ltd. (良品铺子, 603719.SH)
profile: Yang Yinfen (杨银芬) is a co-founder of Wuhan-based snack retailer Bestore (良品铺子), alongside Yang Hongchun and Zhang Guoqiang. Yang was general manager 2017-2022 and chairman/GM from November 2023, then stepped down in March 2025 for personal reasons, remaining a director and strategy-committee member with the title of honorary chairman.
interesting_fact: As chairman, Yang launched Bestore's biggest-ever price cut in late 2023 - nearly 300 products, by up to 45% - framed as a return to 'good quality at friendly prices'.
deep_cut_fact: Yang championed the 'high quality, high looks, high experience' (高品质、高颜值、高体验) brand concept that repositioned Bestore as a premium snack brand; staff call Yang 'Fen Zong' (芬总).
notes: Sources disagree on gender and join date (one says joined 2010 as director/deputy GM; others cite involvement from ~2008). Avoid the price-cut controversy angle; focus on brand-building.
